FilterSettings.description: Which source-chat messages are forwarded. With no filters, every message is eligible.

keywords.description: Forward a message whose text contains any of these words (case-insensitive). A list or a comma-separated string.
keywords.title: Keywords

exclude_keywords.description: Never forward a message whose text contains any of these words (case-insensitive), even if it matches keywords or senders.
exclude_keywords.title: Exclude Keywords

senders.description: Forward a message from any of these sender IDs or names. Combined with keywords using OR: matching either is enough.
senders.title: Senders

FilterSettings.title: FilterSettings

ForwarderConfig.description: A container that forwards messages from one source chat to one target chat.

webhook_url.description: URL WAHA calls to deliver events to this container, for example http://courier-tfl:8000/webhook. Must be unique per container.
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

listen_port.description: Port Courier listens on inside the container; must match the port in webhook_url unless a proxy sits in between.
listen_port.title: Listen Port

log_level.description: Python log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.
log_level.title: Log Level

destination_transport.description: Where messages and alerts are sent: waha (WhatsApp) or matrix.
destination_transport.title: Destination Transport

matrix.description: Matrix account settings; required when destination_transport is matrix, rejected otherwise.

role.description: What this container does: forwarder or health-monitor.
role.title: Role

source_transport.description: Where messages come from; only waha is supported.
source_transport.title: Source Transport

source_chat_id.description: WhatsApp chat ID messages are forwarded from, e.g. 1203…@g.us.
source_chat_id.title: Source Chat Id

target_chat_id.description: Chat or room ID messages are forwarded to: a WhatsApp chat ID, or a Matrix room ID such as !roomid:example.org.
target_chat_id.title: Target Chat Id

include_from_me.description: Also forward messages sent by the linked WhatsApp account. For WhatsApp-to-WhatsApp routes, source and target must then differ.
include_from_me.title: Include From Me

forward_content.description: What to forward: text, media, or both. A media-only route drops captions.
forward_content.title: Forward Content

media_types.description: Attachment kinds to forward when media is forwarded: image, video, audio, file.
media_types.title: Media Types

max_attachment_size.description: Largest attachment in bytes; larger ones are skipped (the text is still sent).
max_attachment_size.title: Max Attachment Size

message_transform.description: Optionally replace source text with a template populated from the first regex match. A non-matching message and its media are skipped.

health_alerts.description: Also watch WAHA session health and send alerts to alert_chat_id. Normally the health-monitor container does this.
health_alerts.title: Health Alerts

alert_chat_id.description: Chat or room that receives health alerts; required when health_alerts is true, rejected otherwise.
alert_chat_id.title: Alert Chat Id

ForwarderConfig.title: ForwarderConfig

HealthMonitorConfig.description: A container that only watches WAHA session health and sends alerts; it forwards nothing.

webhook_url.description: URL WAHA calls to deliver events to this container, for example http://courier-tfl:8000/webhook. Must be unique per container.
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

listen_port.description: Port Courier listens on inside the container; must match the port in webhook_url unless a proxy sits in between.
listen_port.title: Listen Port

log_level.description: Python log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.
log_level.title: Log Level

destination_transport.description: Where messages and alerts are sent: waha (WhatsApp) or matrix.
destination_transport.title: Destination Transport

matrix.description: Matrix account settings; required when destination_transport is matrix, rejected otherwise.

role.description: What this container does: forwarder or health-monitor.
role.title: Role

alert_chat_id.description: Chat or room that receives health and recovery alerts.
alert_chat_id.title: Alert Chat Id

HealthMonitorConfig.title: HealthMonitorConfig

MatrixSettings.description: The Matrix account that posts messages when destination_transport is matrix.

homeserver_url.description: Matrix homeserver URL, for example https://matrix.example.org.
homeserver_url.title: Homeserver Url

access_token.description: Access token of the Matrix account that posts messages. Secret: keep this file private.
access_token.title: Access Token

MatrixSettings.title: MatrixSettings

MessageTransformSettings.description: Extract named values from message text and render a replacement.

pattern.description: Python regular expression with at least one named capture group, such as (?P<crew>...).
pattern.title: Pattern

template.description: Replacement text using $name or ${name} placeholders for named capture groups.
template.title: Template

MessageTransformSettings.title: MessageTransformSettings

WahaSettings.description: How Courier reaches WAHA. The API key is not set here: it comes from WAHA_API_KEY in .env.

url.description: Base URL Courier uses to call WAHA; under Docker Compose this is http://waha:3000.
url.title: Url

session.description: WAHA session (the linked WhatsApp account) this container uses.
session.title: Session

WahaSettings.title: WahaSettings
